    Corners of the ray linearization #

    For A₀ = kP in Setting 8.4: the corners e_x (kP) e_y are spanned by the rays from x to y; the rays of positive degree span a nilpotent subspace; a local corner element with nonzero identity coefficient is a unit, and the only idempotents of a local corner are 0 and e_x. Every nonzero corner element is u b_r w with endpoint units u, w and a ray r (the top of its support in the endpoint chain), and R_x b_s R_y is spanned by the rays of U(s). These are the facts behind "the basis vectors represent exactly the same endpoint-unit orbits" in the proof of Proposition 11.3(3) (binary-families.tex).
